; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

  (lift-SignedInt8ToInt (sel-SignedInt8ToInt SignedInt8ToInt))
  (lift-SignedInt8MaxToInt (sel-SignedInt8MaxToInt SignedInt8MaxToInt))
  (lift-UnsignedUInt8ToInt (sel-UnsignedUInt8ToInt UnsignedUInt8ToInt))
  (lift-UnsignedUInt8MaxToInt (sel-UnsignedUInt8MaxToInt UnsignedUInt8MaxToInt))
  (lift-SignedInt16ToInt (sel-SignedInt16ToInt SignedInt16ToInt))

  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

(declare-const const-1-SignedInt8ToInt SignedInt8ToInt)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun SignedInt8ToInt.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SignedInt8ToInt!mid this) (_ bv128 8))
)

(assert (! (SignedInt8ToInt.inv1 1) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun SignedInt8ToInt.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SignedInt8ToInt!mid_int this) (ite (bvslt (SignedInt8ToInt!mid this) (_ bv0 8)) (- (bv2int (SignedInt8ToInt!mid this)) 256) (bv2int (SignedInt8ToInt!mid this))))
